title_zh: 一签｜文字盲盒与像素签名
title_en: One Fortune | Notes to Draw and Keep
description_zh:
一签是一只随身文字盲盒。按下抽签，拆开一封未知的信：可能是一首古诗、一句冷幽默、一个荒诞脑洞，也可能是生活观察或一点安慰。喜欢哪一句，就连同像素风景收进16格签册，随时翻阅，也能选作自己的个人签名展示。

内置2,200张完整签文：1,980条原创短句与220条古诗词摘句，诗词显示作者和篇名。默认从全库随机抽取；想专门读某类内容，可在类型页选好并确认。同一轮不重复，回首页或重启恢复全库随机。安慰占签库20%、诗词占10%，其余带来更多关于日常、关系、审美与出走的不同说法。

也可以选择“连续来信”，随机看看一组故事的开头，喜欢就选定、顺着读下去。《风停邮局》《月台失物》《海边修灯人》《屋顶花园》四组原创来信，用短句、像素配图和留白连接起完整故事。每组分别记住读到哪里，随时停下，再回来接着读。

封好的信轻轻晃动、拆开、揭晓，短小的音乐盒音效陪着这份期待；音量可调，也能静音。十个像素系列提供320款皮肤、1,920种外观，随机换风景，文字保持原样。收藏卡片可重新展示、换肤或移出，满额时由你确认替换。再抽保留签册和已留签名；读连续信时重启则继续上次的那一页。完全离线，无需配网或付费。签文用于阅读、表达和娱乐，不作未来预测。

封面为玩法示意；四张详情图为实际程序主机渲染与说明，非设备实拍。
description_en:
One Fortune is a pocket surprise box of words. Press to draw and open an unknown letter: a classical verse, a dry joke, a surreal idea, an everyday observation or a little reassurance. Keep a line and its pixel-art scenery in a 16-card album. Browse your favorites whenever you like, or choose one as your personal signature.

Discover 2,200 complete notes: 1,980 original lines and 220 classical Chinese poetry excerpts with author and work title. Draw randomly across the whole collection by default, or confirm one of eight themes on the type selector. Notes do not repeat within a cycle. Returning home or restarting restores whole-bank draws. Reassurance makes up 20% of the collection and poetry 10%; the rest brings different perspectives on daily life, relationships, taste and small outings.

Choose Continuous Letters to preview a random story opening, then select one you like and keep reading. Four original sequences—Windstill Post Office, Platform Lost Property, The Lighthouse Keeper and Rooftop Garden—unfold through short lines, pixel illustrations and pauses. Each story remembers its own reading position, so you can stop and return whenever you like.

A sealed letter shakes, opens and reveals its words, accompanied by brief music-box sounds. Adjust the volume or mute them. Ten pixel-art collections offer 320 skins and 1,920 appearances to discover in shuffled order. Change the scenery while keeping the words. Display a favorite, change its artwork or remove it; replacing a card in a full album requires your confirmation. Drawing again keeps your album and signature. Restarting during a continuous story restores its reading page. Fully offline, with no Wi-Fi setup or payment. The interface and notes are Chinese, intended for reading, expression and entertainment rather than predictions.

The cover is a gameplay illustration. Four detail images use actual application host renders and explanatory graphics, not device photographs.
instructions_zh:
1. 开机即用，无需配网；黑屏按任意键唤醒，长按确定可回首页。
2. 首页确定随机抽签；等揭晓，确定可跳过。结果页上再抽、下换肤、确定收藏并展示。
3. 想换类型，首页上下键打开类型页，选好后确定。“连续来信”先预览：上换一组、下换肤，喜欢就确定读信。
4. 读信时确定下一页、上回看、下换肤。长确定回首页；再选同组即可续读，阅读中重启也会恢复进度。
5. 首页长确定或签名页确定打开签册，上下翻阅、确定整理；长确定返回。卡片页长上调音量、长下开关音效。
instructions_en:
1. Turn on the device; no Wi-Fi setup is needed. Press any button to wake a dark screen. Hold OK to return home.
2. Press OK on home for a random note. Wait for the reveal, or press OK to skip it. On the result, UP draws again, DOWN changes artwork, and OK collects and displays the card.
3. To choose a type, press UP/DOWN on home, select a type, and confirm with OK. Continuous Letters first shows a preview: UP changes the story, DOWN changes artwork, and OK selects it for reading.
4. While reading, OK advances, UP goes back, and DOWN changes artwork. Hold OK to return home; select the same story to resume. Restarting during reading also restores progress.
5. Hold OK on home, or press OK on the signature, to open the album. Browse with UP/DOWN and press OK for actions; hold OK to step back. On a card, hold UP to adjust volume and hold DOWN to toggle sound.
changelog_zh:
• 新增“连续来信”类型，收录《风停邮局》《月台失物》《海边修灯人》《屋顶花园》四组完整原创故事，共120个配图短画面。
• 沿用类型选择入口：先随机预览，上键换组、下键换肤、确定选定；选定后确定下一页，上键回看，下键仍换肤，长确定直接回首页。
• 每组分别保存阅读进度，换组预览不覆盖书签，再选回来即可续读；阅读中重启恢复当前页。
• 短句、配图和留白延续原来的卡片节奏；Mac模拟器同步支持新交互与重启续读。
changelog_en:
• Adds Continuous Letters with four complete original stories: Windstill Post Office, Platform Lost Property, The Lighthouse Keeper and Rooftop Garden, totaling 120 short illustrated pages.
• Uses the existing type selector. Preview a random story, press UP to change it, DOWN to change artwork, and OK to select it. While reading, OK advances, UP goes back, DOWN still changes artwork, and holding OK returns directly home.
• Each story keeps its own bookmark. Previewing another story leaves saved positions intact; selecting it again resumes reading. Restarting during reading restores the current page.
• Short lines, illustrations and empty space retain the original card rhythm. The Mac simulator supports the same interaction and reading recovery.
